entries.title: Team Lead reads the page you are on
entries.summary: open Team Lead from **Ask** and its guide names the page as the sidebar does, lists what your event already has configured there, offers prompts for that page, and links to neighbouring pages your event already has under **More to explore**. When you move to another page mid-conversation, a card marks the change.

entries.title: Site builder: drafts, blocks, and customizable program pages
entries.summary: edits save to a draft and go live when you click Publish, with undo, redo, and a check for broken blocks before publishing. Landing and custom pages are built from 21 block types, including images, video, form links, buttons, and columns. Public Speakers and Agenda pages can use the List, Gallery, Agenda grid, Session list, or Schedule layout with the same fields, filters, and display options as an embed, or import them from one.

entries.title: A wave of Early Access features is now on for everyone
entries.summary: AI Event Agents, Email Campaigns, Automations, Print Agendas, and Notifications & Messaging graduated from Early Access and are on by default for every organization, with no toggle needed.

entries.title: New Navigation for every organization
entries.summary: the grouped sidebar is now the standard navigation. Organizations with an event starting within 30 days keep the old sidebar until that event wraps. A short tour points out where things moved the first time you see it.

entries.title: Marketing, Advocacy, and Live Transcribe on every event
entries.summary: the Marketing module now appears for every event with its Overview, [Advocacy](/marketing/advocacy), and [Live Transcribe](/marketing/live-transcribe). The rest of the module remains an Early Access beta, and the Overview shows only what your organization has.

entries.title: Notes and Messages are now separate on records
entries.summary: contact, session, and group records all carry a team-only **Notes** tab with the same editor, and **Messages** is reserved for conversations delivered to the people on the record. Internal notes that used to live inside session message threads moved to the session's Notes tab. @mention a teammate in a note and they are notified.

entries.title: Portal messaging is off by default
entries.summary: new portals start with **Enable Messaging** off, so opening a reply channel to portal users is a deliberate choice per portal. Portals that were already using messaging keep it on.

entries.title: Poster Gallery has a full guide
entries.summary: the Early Access beta now ships with complete documentation: building a gallery, access modes, embargo and consent, and the visitor experience. Request access per event from Early Access.

entries.title: Studio retired in favour of Agents
entries.summary: the old Remix, persona AI Evaluators, and the paged AI Agenda Builder are replaced by the Editor, Reviewer, and Scheduler agents in the **Agents** tab, which every event now has. Existing persona evaluation plans and their scores remain readable.

entries.title: LiveBuzz theaters from any session field
entries.summary: **LiveBuzz theaters come from** picks what becomes a theater: the room (default) or any dropdown session field such as Format, Track, or Tags, matched by name and created when missing. Topics can come from the same fields.

entries.title: LiveBuzz syncs only the sessions and speakers you choose
entries.summary: **Only sync sessions where** and **Only sync speakers where** add rules on any dropdown field; records that stop matching are unpublished like an un-accept, and skipped ones say which rule they missed.

entries.title: A stopped LiveBuzz sync reads Cancelled
entries.summary: cancelling an in-progress sync from Sync History lands the row as **Cancelled** with a "Sync cancelled" header, not as a Warning. Selecting people and clicking **Sync to LiveBuzz** is documented as an admin override.

entries.title: Maritz RTS pulls large windows in chunks
entries.summary: a first backfill of a big show, or a long gap between runs, is pulled automatically in chunks of at most 9,000 registrants instead of failing at Maritz's cap. Reg State stores Maritz's raw status code.

entries.title: Text colour on Sessionboard Sites
entries.summary: Primary, Accent, and Text Color under Logged-In Experience now apply to the landing page, sign-in cards, and portal, including the evaluator site. Text Color is applied exactly as entered, so check it against your gradient.

entries.title: Up next in the Live Transcribe Console
entries.summary: the session view has an **Up next** panel with a **Next session** button, the ordered queue for the room and the day, and a search to jump to any session, so a producer never returns to the schedule between sessions. A running transcription has to be stopped first.

entries.title: Limit a session manager by Source
entries.summary: a session filter on a team member's role can now use **Source**, so they see only sessions that came in through a given submission form, or were added manually.

entries.title: Can promote sessions permission
entries.summary: promoting submissions to the next round of a funnel evaluation plan needs the new **Can promote sessions** permission under Evaluation Plans. Admins have it; grant it to a custom role to let session managers promote, within their session filter.

entries.title: Participant inventory is enabled by support
entries.summary: the **Participant Inventory** panel in Agenda settings appears once Sessionboard support has enabled the feature for your event.

entries.title: Visit checkbox questions map by answer count
entries.summary: a Visit checkbox with several answers maps to a Sessionboard multi-select dropdown, and a single-answer checkbox maps to a Sessionboard checkbox. The consent picker lists contact forms only.

entries.title: Automation recipients combine
entries.summary: picking several **Send to** choices on a send-email step emails everyone in any selected group, once each.

entries.title: Bundled campaign counts match the send
entries.summary: the recipient count on a one-email-per-session campaign leaves out bounced and unsubscribed contacts, the same as the send does.

entries.title: Reorder subsessions by drag and drop
entries.summary: drag subsessions into your own order on the parent session's Connections tab, with keyboard support. The agenda, embeds, and the public API follow the order; display IDs do not change.

entries.title: Default status for new submissions
entries.summary: each submission form, application form, and awards program chooses the status new entries start in: a standard status or a custom one for session forms, and Submitted, Under review, Accepted, or Rejected for awards. The status toggle is now **Show custom status name to external users**.

entries.title: Participant inventory per role
entries.summary: set a **Min / Max** for each participant role on a session, read them together in the **Role Inventory** grid column, and filter on an **Assignment Status: Role** column to find every session still missing a moderator.

entries.title: Archive fields instead of deleting them
entries.summary: **Archive** hides a field from forms, pickers, and column pickers for the organization or a single event while keeping stored values read-only; restore it from the **Hidden Fields** tab. System fields can be archived but not deleted, and the five core fields can be renamed.

entries.title: Export Advocacy assets
entries.summary: select campaigns and choose **Export assets** to gather every card's asset URL and share link as a table or CSV, or download all rendered cards as a ZIP organised by campaign and card type, delivered by email when it is built.

entries.title: Generate a report from the Evaluators tab
entries.summary: **Options → Generate report** on an evaluation plan's Evaluators tab creates a Custom Report with the tab's columns plus average scores per round, per evaluator question, and across rounds, ready to share, schedule, and export.

entries.title: Generic speaker tags on transcripts
entries.summary: tag a voice as Audience Member, MC / Emcee, Staff Member, Unknown Speaker, or a type your organization adds, with a label to tell several apart, without creating a contact.

entries.title: Edit transcript lines
entries.summary: correct any line of a transcript in place; recaps, exports, search, and the attendee hub use the corrected text, the original is kept behind an **Edited** chip with history, and re-transcribing warns before discarding manual edits.

entries.title: Advocacy session cards group participants by role
entries.summary: a session card's participants line reads "Speakers: A & B · Chairperson: C", using each role's own name (including custom roles) in the event's role order, with the person sharing left out and anyone holding two roles listed once. The same line appears on Quick Launch images and videos.

entries.title: Translated Track, Format, Level, and Language labels in embeds and the API
entries.summary: when you translate those options on the field, the agenda's day tables, the schedule, and session and speaker detail show the translated name in that language, and the public API returns it in `translated_fields`.

entries.title: Live Transcribe Console invites can match several values
entries.summary: a **Limit to specific sessions** rule accepts more than one value, such as **Track is any of Clinical, Surgical**.

entries.title: Participants in the public API
entries.summary: search every contact holding any session role (speaker, chairperson, moderator, or custom), filter by role or look up by email, and list the event's participant roles with their ids. Speakers endpoints are unchanged. [API reference](https://apidocs.sessionboard.com/api-reference/participants/search-participants)
